title: STS2 AI Agent
changeNote: v0.20.0: Combat math now tracks Regent stars, Fool arrows, overflow-energy-to-stars, Frost orb end-of-turn block, and v0.114.0 HitCount; TurnPlan tolerates unplayable draws and auto-ends turn at zero cost when no moves remain; added 3-tier play presets, pre-play highlight dwell with HUD/hotkey/button intercept, cross-run playstyle notes with live counter, editable MaxOutputTokens, dynamic standing-enemy co-op quick tactical commands, per-section /state fault isolation, and fixed a mid-embark close_main_menu_submenu race. Supports Steam stable v0.111.1 and public beta v0.114.0.
